company.name: Complir
company.shortDescription: Complir is a compliance platform designed for the retail sector to help businesses manage regulations and improve product compliance.
company.description:
Complir is a compliance platform tailored for the retail sector, assisting businesses in managing regulations and ensuring product compliance throughout the design and delivery process. It consolidates product data to ensure regulatory adherence and improve transparency across the supply chain. The platform helps retailers maintain standards and stay informed about regulatory updates by automating reporting and simplifying data management. Complir supports retailers in improving compliance and operational efficiency in their product offerings.

https://www.complir.io/

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $500,000, or 19.14% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $138,964, representing 5.32% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,893,036 to $8,404,534, a 1.06x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 73 (-13 over 90 days) and market heat at 63 (-6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
